turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Tracking is created once the order leaves our warehouse. Delivery updates may only appear as late as 1 hour before the courier arrives.

For some deliveries, the timing is carrier-specific:

EDELIV: notification 3 hours before the delivery window, then live tracking 1 hour before arrival.
Geodis/France Express: the tracking link may be sent on the morning of the delivery day.

For the status of your order, please send the order number, purchase email, and phone number used at checkout.

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Once the order is handed to the carrier, delivery times depend on the products and destination:

Mattress only, without a removal service: delivery within 48 hours.
Small parcels: usually 48 to 72 hours, delivered to the ground floor.
Other orders may take longer depending on the delivery location and items in the order.

For the exact status of your order, I still need the order number, the purchase email, and the phone number used at checkout.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail: Unfortunately, we cannot speed up or bring the delivery date forward. Your order will be delivered within the timeframe communicated when you placed it. The courier may call as delivery approaches or if you are absent.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
First, check the carrier’s tracking link. Updates can sometimes appear only as late as 1 hour before delivery.

If a shipped parcel has had no movement for more than 2 days, it needs a carrier investigation. I can check your order once you send the order number, the email used for the purchase, and the phone number used at checkout.

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Log in to your Tediber account, then open Mes Commandes. Select the order to view its tracking information.

The tracking number appears once the order has left our warehouse. If it is not visible yet, tracking has not been generated.

turns.q: Can you check the status of my latest order?
turns.replyTail: I can check your latest order, but I need one of these identifiers first: your order number, the email address used at checkout, or the phone number used for the purchase.

turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail:
I’m sorry your order is showing as delivered when you haven’t received it. Please send me:

Your order number
The email address used for the purchase
The phone number used at checkout

I’ll need these details to check the delivery and arrange the appropriate next step.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
Compensation for a long delivery delay is not automatic. It depends on the specific order and delivery situation and must be reviewed.

Please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used at checkout so I can identify the order.
